title: Systematics of the Dendropsophus leucophyllatus species complex (Anura: Hylidae): Cryptic diversity and the description of two new species.

readScopes.readScope: Dendropsophus leucophyllatus: 2017 restricted concept and neotype, diagnostic sample, photograph-based colour, advertisement/aggressive acoustic accounts, bounded locality/habitat and dated polygon-based conservation recommendation; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus triangulum: Clade H name assignment versus former clade C labels, diagnostic morphology, photograph-based appearance, two acoustic accounts, locality reassignment limits and historical conservation polygon; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus reticulatus: Resurrection of reticulata as reticulatus clade C, large sex-specific diagnostic sample, live/preserved variation, advertisement/aggressive calls, partly contradictory elevation and conservation text; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus arndti: Diagnostic versus holotype size discrepancy, live colour observations, advertisement versus aggressive repertoire, Bolivian locality/perch and attributed predation, older larval-description pointer and historical conservation polygon; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced

Dendropsophus vraemi: Eight-male diagnosis, live holotype versus preserved series appearance, one-locality ecology and dated Data Deficient proposal; no species call or female range inferred; no figures or deposited datasets reproduced
